reviewScope: Read-only static review of the exact keyboard MCU image. No hardware was touched. Source-backed only; not physical validation.

firmware.hashCheck: Intel HEX and decoded image hashes recomputed on 2026-11-19 and matched the repository pins.
firmware.restriction: Source provenance, not an installed firmware version allowlist.

firmwareState.reportBase: 0x100016F8 (status at +0, data size +5, class +6, command +7, arguments from +8; status 5 = not supported)
firmwareState.records: 0x40-byte records, mode at +5; selector (storage, led) returns active (storage 0) or saved (storage 1) record

keyboardTransport.rowSemantics: Arguments [frameId (ignored), row, start, end, RGB from arg4]. Writes keyboard staging at row*0x30+col*3. row=start=end=0xFE clears the staging buffer (corrected from the RZ09-0301 handler at 0xA6B6..0xA6CC, which compares row, start and end with 0xFE; this image was not re-read). OpenBlade sends no frames on this model. Status 5 for row 6 or higher, end 16 or higher, or start greater than end.
keyboardTransport.alternativeRowSemantics: Arguments [storage (ignored), led, row, start, end, RGB from arg5]. LED5 rows 0..5 write keyboard staging. LED5 row 6 returns success without writing. Status 5 for row 7 or higher, end 16 or higher, or start greater than end.
keyboardTransport.forbiddenAddressing: Never send 0F/03 with LED4 or LED0. LED4 rows 1..5 write logo_buffer + row*0x30, past the 0x30-byte logo buffer (RAM overwrite). LED0 rows 0..5 write keyboard staging and LED0 row 6 writes the logo buffer. Send LED5 rows 0..5 only.
keyboardTransport.persistence: Row writes only change RAM staging. Boot reloads staging from storage offset 0x210 with a CRC; the default pattern is written only after a CRC failure.
keyboardTransport.activationSemantics: Custom arm 0xA7C6: LED5 sets flag[0]=1, active record mode 8 and copies staging to output. Completion 0xA8DA with storage 0 only re-initialises the renderer; nothing is persisted. LED4 and LED38 are untouched.
keyboardTransport.alternativeActivation: 03/0A [5,0] custom arm 0xBB56: flag[0]=1, copy, active record mode 8, no persistence; keyboard-only.
keyboardTransport.forbiddenActivation: 0F/02 [0,0,8] also sets the LED4 flag and record. Storage 1 activates and persists the saved bank. Neither is used.
keyboardTransport.excluded: No vapor-chamber or auxiliary frame row: 03/0B rejects row 6 and 0F/03 LED5 row 6 is a silent no-op. The logo has no admissible frame path.

restoration.baseline: Not admitted. The existing Volatile0FTyped built-in contract is unchanged by this review.
restoration.firmwareFacts: 0F/02 Off checks mode!=0 before clearing flag[0]; Static and Breathing clear the flag before their same-effect test; Spectrum clears and applies only while 0x10000301==1. 03/0A built-ins clear flag[0] unconditionally except Spectrum, which is a no-op while 0x10000301==0.

ownershipHazards.fnOverlay: Fn state with record id 5: 0x6D46 / 0x6A36 overlay into output 0x10000D12 only. Transient: staging and the custom flag are untouched, so frames resume when Fn is released. Fn-row keys are overdrawn while Fn is held.
ownershipHazards.gpioEvent: Handler 0x50C6 debounces GPIO 0x50002100 bit 8 (lid or backlight line; semantics not established). Falling edge fades out. Rising edge copies the saved records over the active records and re-initialises the renderer with the saved mode, without clearing the custom flag. Afterwards 0F/82 reports the saved mode while staging is still displayed.
ownershipHazards.gpioMitigation: Treat any 0F/82 read other than mode 8 during a frame session as an external change: stop host rendering and restore through the flag-clearing legacy 03/0A setter. Never infer the frame is off from the reported mode. On the four admitted RZ09-0301/0421/0423/0427 frame models this is implemented as: stop without a write; restore through that setter only when 0F/82 reports exactly the journaled baseline in mode and parameters, when a new host-drawn owner may also adopt the pending baseline. OpenBlade sends no frames on this model.
ownershipHazards.idle: Same structure as RZ09-0509 (fade-only callers); not separately decompiled
ownershipHazards.hostOnlyFlagClears: Class-00 paths clear both flags when device mode is 2 and on the factory-default restore commands. OpenBlade sends neither.
ownershipHazards.boot: Initialised data sets both flags to 0 and init 0x60F8 region (flag stores 0x610A..0x6118) clears them; a reset always leaves custom mode.

windowsDynamicLighting.descriptor: HID LampArray usage page 0x59 usage 0x01 at 0x1023C.
windowsDynamicLighting.sourceSelect: Copy helper 0x69EE for LED5 copies the LampArray buffer 0x1000128E instead of keyboard staging 0x1000190C (0x120 = 6x16x3) when autonomous mode 0x10000301==0 and (policy 0x100002E0==0 or device mode 0x100002C2==0). Otherwise it copies keyboard staging.
windowsDynamicLighting.lampArrayHandler: 0xDFF4..0xE1DA: LampRangeUpdate/LampMultiUpdate write 0x1000128E through 0xDCE4. While autonomous mode is 0 (unless policy 1 with device mode 2 or 3) the firmware sets flag[0]=1, saved record mode 8, activates the saved bank and persists. LampArrayControl stores AutonomousMode in 0x10000301; returning to 1 with device mode 0 clears flag[0], sets saved mode 3 (Spectrum), activates and persists.
windowsDynamicLighting.writers: 0x10000301 is written only by LampArrayControl. 0x100002E0 is written only by 0F/11 at 0xAD2E (store 0xAD30). 0x100002C2 is written by boot, 00/04 at 0xBF02..0xBF22 (store 0xBF14) and the sleep path.
windowsDynamicLighting.consequence: When Windows Dynamic Lighting controls the LampArray, OpenBlade rows land in staging but the keyboard shows the LampArray buffer, and 0F/82 still reports mode 8. Releasing control forces a persisted Spectrum and clears the custom flag. OpenBlade cannot read AutonomousMode through a reviewed command.

limitations: Six rows x 16 columns of the LED5 keyboard only; no logo, vapor-chamber or extra row.
Send LED5 only. LED4 and LED0 frame writes are forbidden (LED4 overwrites RAM past the logo buffer).
Pixels are write-only; a mode-8 baseline is unrestorable and blocks host entry.
0F/82 mode 8 confirms selection only. The GPIO bit-8 event can change the reported mode while staging stays visible.
The Fn overlay overdraws Fn-row and arrow keys while Fn is held.
Display ownership depends on the unreadable LampArray AutonomousMode flag controlled by Windows Dynamic Lighting.
commandSequence: Not admitted. The transport and selection commands are the same as the admitted siblings (03/0B rows plus 0F/02 [0,5,8] confirmed by 0F/82), but display ownership cannot be confirmed.
wouldEstablish: A separately reviewed, readable proof that no LampArray host controls the exact device (AutonomousMode 1) before and during the session, or a reviewed Synapse-style ownership sequence (0F/11 policy plus device mode). 0F/11 [1] rewrites the saved record from a backup and persists, so it needs its own exact-model review.
differencesFrom0529: 16 columns (rowDataSize 52, end column 15) instead of 19 (61, end 18).
No row 6 or second region: no vapor-chamber frame and no LED38 activation.
Restore uses the always flag-clearing legacy 03/0A setter instead of 0F/02 typed setters gated on mode 8, because the GPIO event can move the active mode off 8 while the flag stays set.
LED4 0F/03 rows overflow the logo buffer; the implementation must hard-reject them.
sharedWith0529: Firmware exposes a HID LampArray whose AutonomousMode selects the displayed buffer. The RZ09-0529 KI8110 evidence (2026-11-13-rz09-0529-keyboard-frames.json) records the same hazard, so it is not a difference from 0529.
